scope: Own/public sources, complete input/result/trace data and author independent audits only. Original nested manifests and binary/debug hashes are historical evidence; root MANIFEST binds the files actually shipped. Large exact streams materialize from separately bound deterministic gzip containers. Original failed source history is evidence and is never executed by the runner. Fixed R04 timing blocks are preserved; no timing/performance collection.
